_doc: Player-facing descriptions for the info cards (hover on a computer, the ⓘ button on a phone). One plain sentence or two per building / tool: what it is and what it does. The NUMBERS on a card are not written here — js/ui/about.js works them out from the building data, so they can never go stale. A kind with no row here still gets a card (stats only).

kinds.keep: The heart of your first town. Stores goods for the whole kingdom, homes a few people and scans the land around it for resources.
kinds.tent: The first home anyone gets. It grows into a hut once it has a well in reach.
kinds.hut: A small home. Grows into a cottage with a well in reach and some food.
kinds.cottage: A family home. Grows into a house once it has a market and a church in reach as well.
kinds.house: A good home that pays more tax. Grows into a townhouse with a tavern in reach and bread, ale and cloth in store.
kinds.townhouse: A tall home for many people. Grows into a manor with a healer in reach, furniture and jewellery in store, and safe streets.
kinds.manor: The best home. Pays the most tax, but asks for everything.
kinds.warehouse: Holds goods for the whole kingdom. Haulers bring what workers make here, and builders fetch from here.
kinds.well: Water for every home in reach. Huts and anything better need one.
kinds.woodcutter: Workers fell trees nearby and bring back logs. Trees grow back after a few minutes.
kinds.forager: Workers pick berries from bushes nearby. Cheap early food.
kinds.fisher: Workers fish the water nearby. Must be built by water.
kinds.hunter: A hunter tracks game across a wide area. Good food, but slow.
kinds.quarry: Workers cut stone from rock nearby. Must be built near rock.
kinds.iron_mine: Digs iron ore from a found iron seam. Far from town, its ore goes home by a road route.
kinds.coal_mine: Digs coal from a found coal seam, for smelters, armourers and goldsmiths.
kinds.stone_pit: Digs stone from a found granite seam: faster than a quarry and it never runs out.
kinds.gold_mine: Digs gold ore from a found gold seam, for goldsmiths.
kinds.crystal_mine: Digs mana crystals from a found crystal seam.
kinds.outpost: A wooden fort far from town. Scans the land around it for resources, collects goods from mines near it so they can travel home together, and homes a few people. A road-linked, safe outpost grows into a hamlet once your kingdom is big enough.
kinds.charcoal: Burns logs slowly into coal, when you have no coal seam.
kinds.smelter: Smelts iron ore with coal into iron.
kinds.smithy: Makes tools from iron and planks.
kinds.armourer: Forges weapons from iron and coal.
kinds.bakery: Bakes flour into bread. Townhouses and manors want bread.
kinds.brewery: Brews barley into ale. Townhouses and manors want ale.
kinds.weaver: Weaves wool into cloth. Townhouses and manors want cloth.
kinds.carpenter: Builds furniture from planks. Manors want furniture.
kinds.goldsmith: Makes jewellery from gold ore and coal. Manors want jewellery.
kinds.farm: A grain field. Workers sow and reap; the crop grows back after each harvest.
kinds.barley_farm: A barley field, for the brewery.
kinds.pasture: Sheep that give wool, for the weaver.
kinds.veg_plot: A vegetable patch. Quick to grow, and one more kind of food for better homes.
kinds.market: Every home in reach can shop here. Houses and better need one.
kinds.tavern: Every home in reach can drink here. Townhouses and manors need one.
kinds.healer: Every home in reach gets looked after. Manors need one.
kinds.garden: Makes the street nicer: homes near it are worth more and people are a little happier.
kinds.fountain: Makes the street nicer: homes near it are worth more and people are a little happier.
kinds.statue: Makes the street nicer: homes near it are worth more and people are a little happier.
kinds.fire_station: Firefighters run out to put out fires in reach.
kinds.town_hall: The centre of a new town. Stores goods for the kingdom, scans the land and homes the first settlers.
kinds.dock: A landing on the shore. Put one by a far mine or outpost and one in town, and boats start carrying goods between them on their own.
kinds.chapel: Gives faith, which pays for your ruler powers. Every content person in reach adds to it. Also counts as a church for homes.
kinds.church: A bigger church: more faith per person, a longer reach and a bigger faith store.
kinds.cathedral: The greatest church: the most faith per person, a huge reach and a huge faith store.
kinds.great_fountain: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.bell_tower: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.royal_garden: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.great_statue: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.victory_arch: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.obelisk: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.grand_library: A landmark you have earned. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.sky_spire: A landmark you have earned, crowned with a crystal. Makes the whole area around it much nicer.
kinds.barracks: Lets the town raise more guards. Guards are spread over the town in wards, so every part of it has someone close by.
kinds.guard_post: A post where guards are stationed. It adds guards to your town who stand watch around it and fight anything that comes near. Attack flags can call on them too.
kinds.watchtower: A tower an archer climbs to shoot at raiders. Archers up high hit harder.
kinds.ballista_tower: A giant crossbow. Its bolt goes through several enemies in a line.
kinds.catapult_tower: Hurls rocks a long way and hits everything where they land. Cannot hit enemies right next to it.
kinds.mage_guild: Lets a town with more than eight guards train a mage: a ranged fighter whose spells hit a small area.
kinds.lightning_tower: Lightning that jumps from one enemy to the next. Needs no crew.
kinds.arcane_tower: Missiles that chase their target a long way. Extra damage to brutes and drakes. Needs no crew.
kinds.shield_tower: A dome that soaks up damage to everything under it, then slowly recharges. Needs no crew.
kinds.flame_tower: Sprays fire at enemies close by and sets them alight. Extra damage to undead and siege. Needs no crew.
kinds.station: A stop on the railway. Any track joining two stations becomes a line that carries goods and people.

tools.dirt: A free footpath. Steers where your town grows houses.
tools.gravel: A faster road for people and carts.
tools.stone: The fastest road. Carts travel best on it.
tools.wall_wood: Drag to draw a wall. Towers go at the ends and corners, a gate wherever a road crosses. Strong, but fire burns it.
tools.wall_stone: Drag to draw a wall. Towers go at the ends and corners, a gate wherever a road crosses. Only explosions really hurt it.
tools.firebreak: Drag to clear a strip that fire cannot cross.
tools.track: Drag to lay railway track in straight runs. Start on the end of a track to carry it on. Track can never be destroyed.
tools.settler: A wagon of settlers with logs, stone and food. Tap where it should go and it founds a new town there.
tools.flag: Tap the map to send the guards your towns can spare there. They fight anything hostile in the circle and burn lairs and bandit camps once the defenders fall. While a flag is up, your towns raise extra guards and keep sending more as others fall. Move the flag and they follow; clear it and they come home.
